ideas.title: The Great Wrecking of Minnesota: Uncovering Medicaid Policy Violations
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of Medicaid policy violations in Minnesota and their potential impact on state finances.
questions: What are the root causes of these policy violations?
How much money is at stake?
ideas.insight: This story could expose a significant issue with Medicaid policy language and oversight in Minnesota, potentially leading to a large financial impact on the state.

ideas.title: Trump's Funding Freezes: A Pattern of Politically Motivated Decisions?
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of Trump's funding freezes and their potential impact on various projects and communities.
questions: What is the total amount of funding frozen?
Which projects and communities are affected?
ideas.insight: This story could reveal a pattern of politically motivated funding decisions by the Trump administration, potentially impacting various communities and projects.
